body:
BUG-2221 PR #2928 rework pushed (no force). New head: a1119f02032ee81dbb187881525e440520b71a32. PR title now ends in (Refs BUG-2221), so this merge completes nothing.

Each point of your 2026-10-25 16:15 ruling is implemented:
(a) Only a complete oracle seeds: successful and every record framed. It is pinned to S/R captured before the oracle started. A key with no state file takes no snapshot; a negative answer writes only an empty marker, and the next show is the pinned seeding show.
(b) New equivalence test on a merge-heavy, 3-root DAG at batch sizes 1/2/3/7: the closed set equals rev-list --all (and a from-scratch proof). Every hit placed behind the fence is found.
(d) The full config digest is restored, branch.*/remote.* included.
(e) Every ProvedEmpty, a pure warm read included, re-checks S/R after the walk.
- Serial snapshot overhead: positive and cold shows now pay one rev-parse only. A hit drops the key's state.
- BUG-1993 fixture: restored to 1.2 s, byte-identical to base.
- Owner checks: namespace dirs must be real directories owned by this uid (no-follow). The lock is opened O_NOFOLLOW. Eviction unlinks owned files only.
- Other findings: eviction is now LRU (warm reads touch the file). File symlinks get the external-target fence. The cycle fence uses (dev, inode).

Gate:
- cargo test -p aida-cli-lib --lib -- bug_2221 bug_1993 show_negative: 44 passed (twice).
- aida-cli bug_1993_show_phase_timings: 2 passed.
- make check-ci-fast: 35/35.

Measured on the live repo against live 881f9a3828, AIDA_TELEMETRY=0, load about 3.5:
- Positive BUG-2222: 854-980 ms vs 848-855 ms (parity).
- Negative TASK-2347: cold 1226 ms, seeding 951 ms, then warm 337-368 ms vs 822-856 ms. Identical answer.
AC4 stays open: no fresh guard telemetry, not promoted.

Needs a fresh independent review at the new head.
